authored_by: BP4-CRUX crucible (referee claude-fable-5-1) via six parallel lane agents; every mutation self-authored — no builder proved_it_bites replayed; rows/lines/cells picked by the crucible (USDKNOW rows chosen independently of the builder's self-test, RULINGS rows 6/9/21, B7FIX controls M1b/M1c beyond the brief)
sandbox: git clone --shared -c core.longpaths=true scratch clones per leg branch under the session scratchpad (never the main tree, never a builder worktree); every mutation ran against a crux-green baseline, was restored via `git show HEAD:<path> > <path>` (git checkout/reset are fence-denied), and the baseline re-confirmed green; `git status --short` clean of tracked changes at the end of every lane
environment_notes: Under hython 22.0.400 PYTHONPATH does not bind a scratch tree (the Houdini package inserts the main-tree paths ahead of it); helpers used sys.path.insert(0, <scratch>/python) and printed __file__; pytest bound itself from the scratch rootdir (pyproject.toml pythonpath=['python']). Negative proof: symbols that exist only on the branch (synapse.spatial, tokens.FONT_FLOOR_PX) fail unbound.

Under stock python 3.14 a git archive of only python/synapse/panel has no synapse/__init__.py, so master's regular package beats the scratch namespace candidate even at sys.path[1]; the referee re-archived the whole package before trusting its 5-scale hashes.
Two edits five lines apart fold into one 3-line-context hunk; hunk audits must use -U0 or line ranges (INTAKE-M2).

Karma XPU 22.0.400 substitutes a default distant light when the fixed topology carries none (B7FIX-M1b); the brief's 'drop the camera assignment - must go black' signature does not hold on this build (B7FIX-M1).
